cagey_correction_switch: The cagey correction live per scope (price_edge_cagey_shortlist.correction_live). domestic: "D_pow2" (power-method grid, the correction fitted on it and the 1X2 set from the power quote; released 17 Nov 2026 after passing its declared holdout test against D, docs/plan.md Phase 3b-3) or "D" (the proportional grid with model_version). european (UCL and UEL): "D" only. Where D_pow2 is live, D is kept in shadow (shadow_corrected_no_loss_probability). Each run records the switch and the models in its summary, so it replays exactly; runs before the release record nothing and used D everywhere.
cagey_correction_rollback: Rolling back is setting cagey_correction_live.domestic to "D" (Paul decides; nothing switches automatically): new runs then use D everywhere; D_pow2 runs keep their numbers and still replay exactly. The weekly report says ROLLBACK TRIGGERED (research_monitoring.cagey_rollback_check) when D_pow2 has a worse log loss than D on AH all lines over at least 150 graded domestic matches and 3 weeks, with the week-resampled 95% interval entirely above zero.
